verses.sloka: ततः शूर्पणखा वाक्यम् तत् श्रुत्वा रोम हर्षणम् ।सचिवान् अभ्यनुज्ञाय कार्यम् बुद्ध्वा जगाम ह ॥३-३५-१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā vākyam tat śrutvā roma harṣaṇam ।sacivān abhyanujñāya kāryam buddhvā jagāma ha ॥3-35-1॥

translations.english: Then hearing the horripilating words of Surpanakha, Ravana took leave of the ministers and went thinking about the task ahead of him.
translations.hindi: अरणपकाणड का चोतोसआँ सर्ग पूरा हुआ । _— tS जज पञ्चुत्रिशः सग: । हि >> ततः शूपणखावाकयं तच्छुत्वा रोमहर्पणम्‌ । सचिवानभ्यजुज्ञाय कायं बुद्धवा जगाम सः

verses.sloka: तत् कार्यम् अनुगम्यांतर् यथावत् उपलभ्य च ।दोषाणाम् च गुणानाम् च सम्प्रधार्य बल अबलम् ॥३-३५-२॥
verses.transliteration: tat kāryam anugamyāṁtar yathāvat upalabhya ca ।doṣāṇām ca guṇānām ca sampradhārya bala abalam ॥3-35-2॥

translations.english: Deliberating on the task ahead, duly considering the pros and cons, demerits and merits, strength and weakness, of the issue and having firmly decided within himself, he left for the beautiful coachshed.
translations.hindi: बह मन ही मन अपने कर्तव्य को विचारता र उसकी भलाइ बुराई को सोचता था

verses.sloka: इति कर्तव्यम् इति एव कृत्वा निश्चयम् आत्मनः ।स्थिर बुद्धिः ततो रम्याम् यान शालाम् जगाम ह ॥३-३५-३॥
verses.transliteration: iti kartavyam iti eva kṛtvā niścayam ātmanaḥ ।sthira buddhiḥ tato ramyām yāna śālām jagāma ha ॥3-35-3॥

translations.english: Deliberating on the task ahead, duly considering the pros and cons, demerits and merits, strength and weakness, of the issue and having firmly decided within himself, he left for the beautiful coachshed.

verses.sloka: यान शालाम् ततो गत्वा प्रच्छन्नम् राक्षस अधिपः ।सूतम् संचोदयामास रथः संयुज्यताम् इति ॥३-३५-४॥
verses.transliteration: yāna śālām tato gatvā pracchannam rākṣasa adhipaḥ ।sūtam saṁcodayāmāsa rathaḥ saṁyujyatām iti ॥3-35-4॥

translations.english: Ravana went covertly to the coachshed and to the charioteer to get a chariot harnessed.
translations.hindi: आगे के कर्तव्य को मन में निश्चित कर और स्थिरुद्धि हो बह अपने रमणीक गाड़ीखाने में गया ।!३॥ यानशालां ततो गत्वा प्रच्छन्नो राक्षसाधिपः । सूतं संचोदयामास रथः संयोञ्यतामिति

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तः क्षणेन एव सारथिः लघु विक्रमः ।रथम् संयोजयामास तस्य अभिमतम् उत्तमम् ॥३-३५-५॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ kṣaṇena eva sārathiḥ laghu vikramaḥ ।ratham saṁyojayāmāsa tasya abhimatam uttamam ॥3-35-5॥

translations.english: Thus ordered, the smart charioteer got the chariot of his choice harnessed in an instant.
translations.hindi: रावण की आज्ञा के अनुसार फुतीले सारथी ने, रावण का वह उत्तम रथ, जो उसे पसंद था, क्षण भर में जोत कर तैयार हुआ

verses.sloka: कांचनम् रथम् आस्थाय कामगम् रत्न भूषितम् ।पिशाच वदनैः युक्तम् खरैः कनक भूषणैः ॥३-३५-६॥
verses.transliteration: kāṁcanam ratham āsthāya kāmagam ratna bhūṣitam ।piśāca vadanaiḥ yuktam kharaiḥ kanaka bhūṣaṇaiḥ ॥3-35-6॥

translations.english: The younger brother of Kubera (Ravana), the prosperous lord of the demons ascended the chariot which could go where he desired. Embellished with gold, studded with gems, harnessed with demonfaced donkeys, the chariot rolled towards the ocean, rumbling like a cloud.
translations.hindi: रावण उस इच्छाचारी, सुवर्णरचित तथा रत्नविभूषित रथ में, जिसमें पिशाच तुल्य सुखवाले ऊच्चर जुते थे, बेठा

verses.sloka: मेघ प्रतिम नादेन स तेन धनद अनुजः ।राक्षसाधिपतिः श्रीमान् ययौ नद नदी पतिम् ॥३-३५-७॥
verses.transliteration: megha pratima nādena sa tena dhanada anujaḥ ।rākṣasādhipatiḥ śrīmān yayau nada nadī patim ॥3-35-7॥

translations.english: The younger brother of Kubera (Ravana), the prosperous lord of the demons ascended the chariot which could go where he desired. Embellished with gold, studded with gems, harnessed with demonfaced donkeys, the chariot rolled towards the ocean, rumbling like a cloud.
translations.hindi: चलते समय मेघ तुल्य शब्द करने वाले उस रथ पर, कुवेर का छोटा भाई राक्षसेश्वर श्रीमान्‌ रावण सवार हो, समुद्र की ओर रवाना हुआ

verses.sloka: स श्वेत वाल व्यजनः श्वेतः छत्रो दशाननः ।स्निग्ध वैदूर्य संकाश तप्त कान्चन भूषणः ॥३-३५-८॥
verses.transliteration: sa śveta vāla vyajanaḥ śvetaḥ chatro daśānanaḥ ।snigdha vaidūrya saṁkāśa tapta kāncana bhūṣaṇaḥ ॥3-35-8॥

translations.english: Ravana, enemy of the gods, slayer of towering sages, with white yaktail fans, and white parasols, shining like smooth vaidurya, wearing pure gold earrings, clad in attractive attire, ten necks with twenty strong hands, ten heads looking like ten mountain peaks, a cloud in the sky encircled by lightnings and accompanied by cranes, ascended the chariot that could go wherever he desired.
translations.hindi: उस समय रावण श्वेत छत्र और ' श्वेत चँवर से शोभायमान हो रहा था| रावण के शरीर की कान्ति वैडूये मणि की तरह थी, “ ओर बह कानों में बढ़िया सोने के कुण्डल पहिने हुए था

verses.sloka: दशग्रीवो विम्शति भुजो दर्शनीय परिच्छदः ।त्रिदश अरिः मुनीन्द्र घ्नो दश शीर्ष इव अद्रि राट् ॥३-३५-९॥
verses.transliteration: daśagrīvo vimśati bhujo darśanīya paricchadaḥ ।tridaśa ariḥ munīndra ghno daśa śīrṣa iva adri rāṭ ॥3-35-9॥

translations.english: Ravana, enemy of the gods, slayer of towering sages, with white yaktail fans, and white parasols, shining like smooth vaidurya, wearing pure gold earrings, clad in attractive attire, ten necks with twenty strong hands, ten heads looking like ten mountain peaks, a cloud in the sky encircled by lightnings and accompanied by cranes, ascended the chariot that could go wherever he desired.

verses.sloka: कामगम् रथम् आस्थाय शुशुभे राक्षसाधिपः ।विद्युन् मण्डलवान् मेघः स बलाक इव अंबरे ॥३-३५-१०॥
verses.transliteration: kāmagam ratham āsthāya śuśubhe rākṣasādhipaḥ ।vidyun maṇḍalavān meghaḥ sa balāka iva aṁbare ॥3-35-10॥

translations.english: Ravana, enemy of the gods, slayer of towering sages, with white yaktail fans, and white parasols, shining like smooth vaidurya, wearing pure gold earrings, clad in attractive attire, ten necks with twenty strong hands, ten heads looking like ten mountain peaks, a cloud in the sky encircled by lightnings and accompanied by cranes, ascended the chariot that could go wherever he desired.

translations.english: Valiant Ravana wentwatching the mountains full of thousands of trees bearing flowers and fruits on the shore of the sea.

translations.english: (The area) surrounded on all sides with lotusladen ponds filled with cool, sacred water, sprawling hermitages with elevated altars.
translations.hindi: शीतल और निर्मल जल से भरे और चारों ओर कमल पुष्पा से सुशोभित तालाबों तथा चारों ओर चबूतरों से घिरे हुए बड़े बड़े आश्रमं से वह देश शोभित था

verses.sloka: कदल्य अटवि संशोभम् नालिकेर उपशोभितम् ।सालैः तालैः तमालैः च तरुभिः च सुपुष्पितैः ॥३-३५-१३॥
verses.transliteration: kadalya aṭavi saṁśobham nālikera upaśobhitam ।sālaiḥ tālaiḥ tamālaiḥ ca tarubhiḥ ca supuṣpitaiḥ ॥3-35-13॥

translations.english: The place covered with banana plants and coconut trees as well as blossoming sal and tamala trees was looking extremely beautiful.
translations.hindi: केलों का बन चारों ओर लगा था, भोज्य अन्न की राशि एकत्र . थी । नारियल के वरक्त शोभायमान्‌ थे | साल, ताल, तमाल आदि नाना प्रकार के फूले हुए पेड़ लगे थे

verses.transliteration: atyanta niyata āhāraiḥ śobhitam parama ṛṣibhiḥ ।nāgaiḥ suparṇaiḥ gaṁdharvaiḥ kiṁnaraiḥ ca sahasraśaḥ ॥3-35-14॥

translations.english: The place looked charming with nagas, garudas, gandharvas, kinneras in their thousands and with the descendants of ajas, vaikhanasas, valakhilyas and with those who drink the rays of Sun and Moon for survival, with sages who were highly disciplined in the intake of food, spiritually accomplished and selfcontrolled hermits and charanas.

verses.transliteration: jita kāmaiḥ ca siddhaiḥ ca cāraṇaiḥ ca upaśobhitam ।ājaiḥ vaikhānasaiḥ māṣaiḥ vālakhilyaiḥ marīcipaiḥ ॥3-35-15॥

translations.english: The place looked charming with nagas, garudas, gandharvas, kinneras in their thousands and with the descendants of ajas, vaikhanasas, valakhilyas and with those who drink the rays of Sun and Moon for survival, with sages who were highly disciplined in the intake of food, spiritually accomplished and selfcontrolled hermits and charanas.

verses.sloka: दिव्य आभरण माल्याभिः दिव्य रूपाभिः आवृतम् ।क्रीडा रति विधिज्ञाभिः अप्सरोभिः सहस्रशः ॥३-३५-१६॥
verses.transliteration: divya ābharaṇa mālyābhiḥ divya rūpābhiḥ āvṛtam ।krīḍā rati vidhijñābhiḥ apsarobhiḥ sahasraśaḥ ॥3-35-16॥

translations.english: (The place was) full of apsaras in their thousands and paragons of beauty adorned with divine ornaments and garlands, and experts in lovesports.
translations.hindi: जहाँ पर, दिव्य आभूषण और दिव्य पुष्पहारों से भूषित, दिव्य रूप बाली.और कीड़ा ब रति की विधि जानने वाली हज़ारों अप्सराएँ भी थीं

verses.sloka: सेवितम् देव पत्नीभिः श्रीमतीभिः उपासितम् ।देव दानव सन्घैः च चरितम् तु अमृत अशिभिः ॥३-३५-१७॥
verses.transliteration: sevitam deva patnībhiḥ śrīmatībhiḥ upāsitam ।deva dānava sanghaiḥ ca caritam tu amṛta aśibhiḥ ॥3-35-17॥

translations.english: It was chosen by prosperous wives of gods as a reosrt. Hosts of gods and demons were wandering, there in the hope of tasting nectar.

verses.transliteration: haṁsa kraunca plava ākīrṇam sārasaiḥ saṁpraṇāditam ।vaidūrya prastaram snigdham sāṁdram sāgara tejasā ॥3-35-18॥

translations.english: (It was ) full of small floats, flocks of swans, kraunchas, sarasas cackling in the ponds, with great joy. It had stretches of vaidurya stones on the shore and shone with the radiance of the sea

verses.sloka: पाण्डुराणि विशालानि दिव्य माल्य युतानि च ।तूर्य गीत अभिजुष्टानि विमानानि समंततः ॥३-३५-१९॥
verses.transliteration: pāṇḍurāṇi viśālāni divya mālya yutāni ca ।tūrya gīta abhijuṣṭāni vimānāni samaṁtataḥ ॥3-35-19॥

translations.english: Speeding along, the brother of Kubera (Ravana) saw palewhite, spacious aerial chariots on all sides controlled by those who had conquered the higher worlds by their penances. These chariots, decked with heavenly garlands, and ringing with divine music could fly where one desired. He saw gandharvas and apsaras as well.

verses.sloka: तपसा जित लोकानाम् कामगान् अभिसंपतन् ।गन्धर्व अप्सरसः चैव ददर्श धनदानुजः ॥३-३५-२०॥

translations.english: Speeding along, the brother of Kubera (Ravana) saw palewhite, spacious aerial chariots on all sides controlled by those who had conquered the higher worlds by their penances. These chariots, decked with heavenly garlands, and ringing with divine music could fly where one desired. He saw gandharvas and apsaras as well.
translations.hindi: जिन लोगों ने अपने तप के फल से अनेक लोकों में जाने का अधिकार आप्त कर लिआ है, उनके विमान कुवेर के भाई रावण को रास्ते में मिले । कुवेर के छोटे भाई र i | अथात्‌ रावण ने, गन्धर्वः अर अप्सराओं को भी वहाँ देखा

verses.transliteration: niryāsa rasa mūlānām caṁdanānām sahasraśaḥ ।vanāni paśyan saumyāni ghrāṇa tṛpti karāṇi ca ॥3-35-21॥

translations.english: He saw thousands of tree trunks with finesmelling resins and sandalwood trees.
translations.hindi: बहा पर रावण ने सुगन्ध से नासिका को तृप्त करने वाले हजार चन्दन के वृक्षों तथा हींग के वृक्षों के वन देखे

verses.sloka: अगुरूणाम् च मुख्यानाम् वनानि उपवनानि च ।तक्कोलानाम् च जात्यानाम् फलानाम् च सुगन्धिनाम् ॥३-३५-२२॥
verses.transliteration: agurūṇām ca mukhyānām vanāni upavanāni ca ।takkolānām ca jātyānām phalānām ca sugandhinām ॥3-35-22॥

translations.english: (He saw) very fine aguru trees in the forest as well as pleasuregroves of takkola fruits, fragrant trees of a fine variety and fragrant nutmegs.

verses.sloka: पुष्पाणि च तमालस्य गुल्मानि मरिचस्य च ।मुक्तानाम् च समूहानि शुष्यमाणानि तीरतः ॥३-३५-२३॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpāṇi ca tamālasya gulmāni maricasya ca ।muktānām ca samūhāni śuṣyamāṇāni tīrataḥ ॥3-35-23॥

translations.english: (He saw) tamala flowers in bloom, pepper shrubs in clusters and hoards of pearls kept for drying on the shores.
translations.hindi: तमाल के फूलों को, कालीमिचं के छोटे वृक्षों को, मोतियों के ढेर को, जो समुद्र फे तट पर पड़े सूख रहे थे, रावण ने देखा

verses.sloka: शैलानि प्रवरान् चैव प्रवाल निचयान् तथा ।कांचनानि च शृंगाणि राजतानि तथैव च ॥३-३५-२४॥
verses.transliteration: śailāni pravarān caiva pravāla nicayān tathā ।kāṁcanāni ca śṛṁgāṇi rājatāni tathaiva ca ॥3-35-24॥

translations.english: He saw stretches of conches, heaps of corals and mounds of gold and silver too.
translations.hindi: शक्लो के ढेर और मूंगों के ढेर ओर सोने तथा चाँदी के पहाड़ों को, जो चारों तरफ थे, उसने देखा

verses.sloka: प्रस्रवाणि मनोज्ञानि प्रसन्नानि अद्भुतानि च ।धन धान्य उपपन्नानि स्त्री रत्नैः आवृतानि च ॥३-३५-२५॥
verses.transliteration: prasravāṇi manojñāni prasannāni adbhutāni ca ।dhana dhānya upapannāni strī ratnaiḥ āvṛtāni ca ॥3-35-25॥

translations.english: He went watching fascinating waterfalls, pleasing ponds, cities filled with wealth and grain, looking splendid with beautiful women and full of elephants, horses and chariots.

verses.sloka: हस्ति अश्व रथ गाढानि नगराणि विलोकयन् ।तम् समम् सर्वतः स्निग्धम् मृदु संस्पर्श मारुतम् ॥३-३५-२६॥
verses.transliteration: hasti aśva ratha gāḍhāni nagarāṇi vilokayan ।tam samam sarvataḥ snigdham mṛdu saṁsparśa mārutam ॥3-35-26॥

translations.english: It was a veritable heaven with the plain land flooded with the backwaters of the sea and gentle breeze blowing.
translations.hindi: उनमें हाथी घोड़े भरे हुए थे। वे घरों की पंक्तियों से युक्त थे। ऐसे कितने ही नगर रावण ने देखे । रावण ने, शीतल, मन्द- सुगन्ध पवन सहित समुद्र का तट, जो स्वर्ग जैसा सुन्दर जान पड़ता था देखा

verses.sloka: अनूपे सिन्धु राजस्य ददर्श त्रिदिव उपमम् ।तत्र अपश्यत् स मेघ आभम् न्यग्रोधम् मुनिभिर् वृतम् ॥३-३५-२७॥
verses.transliteration: anūpe sindhu rājasya dadarśa tridiva upamam ।tatra apaśyat sa megha ābham nyagrodham munibhir vṛtam ॥3-35-27॥

translations.english: He saw a banyan tree with its branches spread on all sides measuring a hundred yojanas, looking like a cloud and providing shelter to the sages.
translations.hindi: रावण चलते, चलते वहाँ पहुँचा जहाँ एक बड़ा भारी बरगद का पेड़ था और जो मेघ के समान बड़ा और मुनिया से सेवित २ [

verses.sloka: समंतात् यस्य ताः शाखाः शत योजनम् आयताः ।यस्य हस्तिनम् आदाय महा कायम् च कच्छपम् ॥३-३५-२८॥
verses.transliteration: samaṁtāt yasya tāḥ śākhāḥ śata yojanam āyatāḥ ।yasya hastinam ādāya mahā kāyam ca kacchapam ॥3-35-28॥

translations.english: In the past, the mighty Garuda brought an elephant and a huge tortoise and sat on a branch of this tree to feed on them.
translations.hindi: चा उसकी शाखाएं चारों ओर सो योजन (चार सो कोस) के घेरे में फेलो हुई थीं । किसी समय महाबलवान गरुड़ जी एक बड़े भारी हाथी ओर कछुए को

verses.sloka: भक्षार्थम् गरुडः शाखाम् आजगाम महाबलः ।तस्य ताम् सहसा शाखाम् भारेण पतगोत्तमः ॥३-३५-२९॥
verses.transliteration: bhakṣārtham garuḍaḥ śākhām ājagāma mahābalaḥ ।tasya tām sahasā śākhām bhāreṇa patagottamaḥ ॥3-35-29॥

translations.english: Due to the weight of this best of birds, the mighty Garuda, the leafy branch at once broke down.

verses.sloka: सुपर्णः पर्ण बहुलाम् बभंज अथ महाबलः ।तत्र वैखानसा माषा वालखिल्या मरीचिपाः ॥३-३५-३०॥
verses.transliteration: suparṇaḥ parṇa bahulām babhaṁja atha mahābalaḥ ।tatra vaikhānasā māṣā vālakhilyā marīcipāḥ ॥3-35-30॥

translations.english: Gathered together under the great tree were great sages like vaikhanasas, mashas, marichipas, valakhilyas, ajas and dhumras.
translations.hindi: क २७ वे श्लोक के प्रथम पाद का अर्थ २३ ३३ एज प्रथम पाद का श्रर्थ २६ वे श्लो सम्मिलित है । ba वा० रा? अ०-- १८ २७४ अरणयकाण्डे बह शाखा जो टूटी थी, उसमें बहुत पत्ते लगे हुए थे। इसी शाखा पर वैखानस, माघ, मरीचिप, बालखिल्य, अज और धूम्र आदि बड़े बड़े ऋषि इकट्ठे थे । इन महर्पियों पर अनुमह कर गरुड़ जी ने उस सो योजन वाली शाखा को एक पेर से और उन दोनों जन्तु को दूसरे पेर से पकड़ा । फिर वहाँ से बड़े वेग से गरुड़ जी चले गए। दूसरे पेर से गज और कच्छप को दवा, गरुड़ ने उनका माँस खाया

verses.sloka: अजा बभूवुः धूम्राः च संगताः परमर्षयः ।तेषाम् दयाअर्थम् गरुडः ताम् शाखाम् शत योजनाम् ॥३-३५-३१॥
verses.transliteration: ajā babhūvuḥ dhūmrāḥ ca saṁgatāḥ paramarṣayaḥ ।teṣām dayāartham garuḍaḥ tām śākhām śata yojanām ॥3-35-31॥

translations.english: Out of compassion for the (endangered) seers Garuda carried away that hundredyojanalong branch along with the elephant and the tortoise with great speed.

verses.sloka: भग्नम् आदाय वेगेन तौ च उभौ गज कच्छपौ ।एक पादेन धर्म आत्मा भक्षयित्वा तत् आमिषम् ॥३-३५-३२॥
verses.transliteration: bhagnam ādāya vegena tau ca ubhau gaja kacchapau ।eka pādena dharma ātmā bhakṣayitvā tat āmiṣam ॥3-35-32॥

translations.english: Righteous Garuda, the best among the birds, stood on one foot and ate the flesh (of elephant and tortoise) and with the branch of the tree, destroyed the settlement of the demons. Over the destruction of the demons and deliverance of the great seers he felt immeasurable happiness.

verses.sloka: निषाद विषयम् हत्वा शाखया पतगोत्तमः ।प्रहर्षम् अतुलम् लेभे मोक्षयित्वा महामुनीन् ॥३-३५-३३॥
verses.transliteration: niṣāda viṣayam hatvā śākhayā patagottamaḥ ।praharṣam atulam lebhe mokṣayitvā mahāmunīn ॥3-35-33॥

translations.english: Righteous Garuda, the best among the birds, stood on one foot and ate the flesh (of elephant and tortoise) and with the branch of the tree, destroyed the settlement of the demons. Over the destruction of the demons and deliverance of the great seers he felt immeasurable happiness.
translations.hindi: फिर उस शाखा। से निषादों के देश का संहार कर और उन सुनियो को बचा कर, वे बहुत प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: स तेन तु प्रहर्षेण द्विगुणी कृत विक्रमः ।अमृत आनयनार्थम् वै चकार मतिमान् मतिम् ॥३-३५-३४॥
verses.transliteration: sa tena tu praharṣeṇa dviguṇī kṛta vikramaḥ ।amṛta ānayanārtham vai cakāra matimān matim ॥3-35-34॥

translations.english: Quite happy, his energy redoubled, wise Garuda made up his mind to obtain nectar.
translations.hindi: उस हे के कारण सतिमान गरुड़ जी का पराक्रम दूना हो गया ओर उन्होंने असत लाने के लिए उद्योग किआ

verses.sloka: अयो जालानि निर्मथ्य भित्त्वा रत्न गृहम् वरम् ।महेन्द्र भवनात् गुप्तम् आजहार अमृतम् ततः ॥३-३५-३५॥
verses.transliteration: ayo jālāni nirmathya bhittvā ratna gṛham varam ।mahendra bhavanāt guptam ājahāra amṛtam tataḥ ॥3-35-35॥

translations.english: Twisting and twirling the grills of the window, he broke open the room made of gems and quietly carried away the nectar from Indra's mansion.
translations.hindi: गरुड जी लोहे के जाल को काट और रत्ननिर्भित घर को फोड़, इन्द्र के घर में सुरक्षित रखे हुए असत को ले आए

verses.sloka: तम् महर्षि गणैः जुष्टम् सुपर्ण कृत लक्षणम् ।नाम्ना सुभद्रम् न्यग्रोधम् ददर्श धनद अनुजः ॥३-३५-३६॥
verses.transliteration: tam maharṣi gaṇaiḥ juṣṭam suparṇa kṛta lakṣaṇam ।nāmnā subhadram nyagrodham dadarśa dhanada anujaḥ ॥3-35-36॥

translations.english: Ravana, the younger brother of Kubera, beheld that banyan tree called Subhadram ,which was a favoured resort of the sages bearing the ensignia of Garuda.
translations.hindi: त तथा महापिंगण सेनि नामक बट वृक्ष को देखता हुआ

verses.sloka: तम् तु गत्वा परम् पारम् समुद्रस्य नदी पतेः ।ददर्श आश्रमम् एकांते पुण्ये रम्ये वनांतरे ॥३-३५-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tam tu gatvā param pāram samudrasya nadī pateḥ ।dadarśa āśramam ekāṁte puṇye ramye vanāṁtare ॥3-35-37॥

translations.english: Ravana crossed over to the other side of the sea, the lord of rivers, and beheld a hermitage in a beautiful, secluded, sacred place in the middle of the forest.
translations.hindi: समुद्र के उस पार जा कर रावण ने एकान्त, पवित्र और रमणीक वन प्रदेश में कृष्ण-मृग-चमे को ओढ़े हुए और जटाजूट सिर पर रखाए, नियमित आहार करने वाले मारीच नामक राक्षस को देखा

verses.sloka: तत्र कृष्ण अजिन धरम् जटा वल्कल धारिणम् ।ददर्श नियत आहारम् मारीचम् नाम राक्षसम् ॥३-३५-३८॥
verses.transliteration: tatra kṛṣṇa ajina dharam jaṭā valkala dhāriṇam ।dadarśa niyata āhāram mārīcam nāma rākṣasam ॥3-35-38॥

translations.english: There he saw a demon Maricha, by name, clad in dark deerskin and bark ,with matted hair and living on restricted food.

verses.sloka: स रावणः समागम्य विधिवत् तेन रक्षसा ।मारीचेन अर्चितो राजा सर्व कामैः अमानुषैः ॥३-३५-३९॥
verses.transliteration: sa rāvaṇaḥ samāgamya vidhivat tena rakṣasā ।mārīcena arcito rājā sarva kāmaiḥ amānuṣaiḥ ॥3-35-39॥

translations.english: When king Ravana reached there, Maricha received him in accordance with tradition and made worshipful offering to the king, fulfilling all his superhuman desires.

verses.sloka: तम् स्वयम् पूजयित्वा च भोजनेन उदकेन च ।अर्थोपहितया वाचा मारीचो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-३५-४०॥
verses.transliteration: tam svayam pūjayitvā ca bhojanena udakena ca ।arthopahitayā vācā mārīco vākyam abravīt ॥3-35-40॥

translations.english: Maricha extended his hospitality with appropriate food and water and said with meaningful words:
translations.hindi: मारीच ने भोजन के लिए भोज्य पदार्थ और पीने के लिए जल स्वयं दे, रावण का सत्कार कर, यह अर्थयुक्त वचन कहा

verses.sloka: कच्चित् ते कुशलम् राजन् लंकायाम् राक्षसेश्वर ।केन अर्थेन् पुनः त्वम् वै तूर्णम् एव इह आगतः ॥३-३५-४१॥
verses.transliteration: kaccit te kuśalam rājan laṁkāyām rākṣaseśvara ।kena arthen punaḥ tvam vai tūrṇam eva iha āgataḥ ॥3-35-41॥

translations.english: O king O lord of the demons hope all is well in Lanka. What brings you here again so soon ?
translations.hindi: हे राक्षसेश्वर ! कहिए लड्डा में कुशल तो है। तुम्हारे पुनः इतनी जल्दी यहाँ अनि का कारण क्या है ?

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तो महातेजा मारीचेन स रावण ।ततः पश्चात् इदम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् वाक्य कोविदः ॥३-३५-४२॥
verses.transliteration: evam ukto mahātejā mārīcena sa rāvaṇa ।tataḥ paścāt idam vākyam abravīt vākya kovidaḥ ॥3-35-42॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by Maricha, the effulgent, eloquent Ravana replied with these words: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfifth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: इति पञ्चत्रिशः सग; ॥ जब मारीच ने यह कहा, तब वात बनाने में निपुण महातेजस्वी रावण ने इस प्रकार कहना आरम्भ किआ
